summary:
Plan of w101 written (plan.md, parts 1-5) for supervision r1, r20, r59-r63.
Decisions: top-level `workers` key in .shop/delivery.toml, default 4, read once at start; a malformed file gives r10's error, not a traceback.
One slot pool caps every worker; r20's disjoint claims gate implementations; research and plan of different work-items run together.
A work-item with a blocked_by naming a work-item that is not green (resolved across initiatives) is not movable; the same guard also runs in Workers.worker.
Each merge happens in one lock hold at its implementer's end, so merges follow end order.
session.json gains a `transcript` path, including the branch review's (r49 calls it a stage).
New modules: scripts/supervise_pool.py and tests/scenarios/supervision_parallel_steps.py; supervise_faults.py dropped from the set.
Blocked: w101 lists no ## Retires, yet the deprecated r1 (line 9) and r20 (line 430) scenarios break under r59/r60, and the implementer may only retire listed scenarios.
questions: w101 has no ## Retires, but delivery#r17 and design-decision/held-scenarios would list the deprecated scenarios at features/supervision.feature lines 9 (r1, '... one worker at a time ... (deprecated)'), 396 (r20, '... merged one at a time (deprecated)') and 430 (r20, '... no more than two ... (deprecated)'), and red-green#r2 lets the implementer retire only what Retires lists. Should w101 list all three under ## Retires? Reading A (yes, all three): the implementer retires them with `features retire`, the whole suite passes, and the person sees w101 merged and green. Reading B (no Retires): lines 9 and 430 fail once r59/r60 land; r43 does not count them as expected because w101 accepts r1 and r20, so the whole-suite run before the merge fails and the person sees w101 awaiting-answer, its branch kept.
